messages:
sara-support: FYI urgent escalation from AcmeCorp. They see 500s on generation endpoints and missing audit events for a handful of requests. Customer is asking for patch ETA and mitigations. correlation_id=acme-2026-03-17-08

miguel-eng-sre: Can you paste an example request + response? Also which model/route and region?

sara-support: Pasted below (redacted token). Happened in us-west-2 on /v1/chat/generate.

sara-support: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-large-1\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"summarize logs\"}]}'
```

sara-support: Response from customer: 500 Internal Server Error, body: `{\"error\":\"internal_error\",\"code\":\"INFER-502\"}`, log snippet below: 

sara-support: ```
[2026-03-17T08:11:23Z] correlation_id=acme-2026-03-17-08 request_id=xyz123 module=runtime error=\"kv-cache miss\"
[2026-03-17T08:11:23Z] correlation_id=acme-2026-03-17-08 request_id=xyz123 module=kms sign_error=\"hsm: firmware reject\"
[2026-03-17T08:11:23Z] correlation_id=acme-2026-03-17-08 request_id=xyz123 module=audit warn=\"event_write_failed\"
```

anya-security: this looks like the HSM firmware failure we flagged in internal tracker. I see related automated alerts: deploy-bot posted a firmware CVE advisory earlier. Need to confirm whether keys were affected or just signing ops failing.

ops-oncall: Adding oncall. tagging @miguel-eng-sre and @anya-security. Setting priority=P0 until we confirm data integrity/audit retention impact.

john-customer-success: Customer is escalating to their compliance team. They want an ETA and whether logs were dropped (retention) or just delayed. Also they reported an invoice spike tied to retries.

anya-security: Quick answers: 1) If audit write failed, events may be dropped unless cached locally (we have short retry queue). 2) Billing spike likely due to automatic client-side retries + server-side retrying. We'll need to confirm rate-limiter behavior.

miguel-eng-sre: Reprobed on staging with a forced HSM reject (dev HSM shim). I can reproduce the 500 and the audit write error. Repro steps: set env REDWOOD_HSM_FAIL=true then run the curl above. Observed retry loop and backlog growth.

miguel-eng-sre: Temporary mitigations we can flip now: 
- toggle software-kms-fallback: true (forces signing with SW KMS)
- enable-audit-buffering: longer retention for local queue

miguel-eng-sre: Executed toggles in hosted control plane (edge config). Rolling takes ~90s. I also created a canary for 5% traffic in us-west-2.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: feature-toggle/software-kms-fallback -> canary(us-west-2,5%) by miguel-eng-sre at 2026-03-17T08:22:10Z

audit-bot: audit_queue: current_len=42 retried=12 dropped=0 since toggle.

sara-support: Customer confirmed reduced 500s after toggle but asks for formal patch ETA and plan for Dedicated/Private customers who use on-prem HSMs.

anya-security: Patch plan: 
- We have a firmware mitigation (workaround) v0.1 that avoids failing signing path, deployable within 6 hours for Redwood-hosted HSM fleet (hotfix with automated rollout).
- Upstream vendor is preparing CVE patch; vendor ETA ~48-72 hours for full firmware release.
- For Dedicated customers, we'll offer a coordinated rolling maintenance window (12-24 hours) to apply hotfix or switch to SW KMS; will need customer approval.
- For Private/on-prem customers, provide step-by-step mitigation and verification scripts.

alice-legal: Need to confirm retention guarantees for audit logs. If events were dropped, we must notify affected customers per SLA and compliance obligations. Prepare a targeted notification draft.

john-customer-success: I'll draft the customer message: acknowledging issue, immediate mitigation (software KMS fallback), ETA for hosted patch (6h), guidance for Dedicated/Private and link to support playbook. Customer wants remediation confirmation when their lost events are recovered or if irretrievable.

miguel-eng-sre: Action items: 
- (now) keep software-kms-fallback on until patch validated (miguel)
- (within 2h) run full audit queue reconciliation job and report dropped vs delayed events (ops-oncall)
- (within 6h) push hosted hotfix and validate signing success on canary (miguel + deploy-bot)
- (12-24h) schedule Dedicated rolling updates and send runbook to private customers (anya + john)

ops-oncall: Kicking off audit-reconciliation job, job_id=arj-179208. Will update queue metrics here.

sara-support: Customer requested proof of audit delivery for their correlation_id range. Is there a way to export events or show proof of forwarding?

audit-bot: export ready: https://internal.redwood/audit-exports/arj-179208?range=acme-2026-03-17-08 (auth required)

sara-support: Sent link to customer (redacted). They're asking for a security contact for an NDA-level conversation.

anya-security: I'll take the customer security call. Please cc alice-legal and john-customer-success.

miguel-eng-sre: Status update at 08:55Z: canary shows signing success, error rate down from 6%->0.3%. audit_queue drained from 42->4, no dropped events reported so far.

john-customer-success: Customer replied: thanks, they'll hold off on escalation if we provide final patch summary and a post-incident review that covers root cause, affected keys, and retention impact.

alice-legal: Prepare a compliance statement template. We'll need to know if any keys were exfiltrated (unlikely based on initial indicators) before making assertions.

anya-security: Preliminary root cause: HSM firmware microcode bug that under specific key formats rejects signing calls leading to retry loops and audit write failures. Assigning tracker CVE-2026-4555 internally.

miguel-eng-sre: I'll schedule the hosted hotfix push at 14:00 UTC after canary validation and monitoring window. If all green we roll to 100% in 2 hours.

sara-support: Thanks team. I'll keep customer posted every hour. tagging @john-customer-success to update SLA notification if needed. :thumbsup: 

ops-oncall: audit-reconciliation complete at 09:02Z. summary: attempted=58 delivered=58 dropped=0. storing/export location: /mnt/audit-exports/arj-179208-summary.json

john-customer-success: Passing full reconciliation report to customer now and scheduling the security call for 11:00 UTC.

anya-security: After call we'll prepare postmortem and required CVE disclosure timeline. For now mitigation is active and hosted rollout planned.

sara-support: closing loop with customer — will reopen thread if they escalate.

miguel-eng-sre: Noted. I'll leave software-kms-fallback on until EOD PST and monitor.

sara-support: thread closed (for now).
